title: Nothing shows whether a project's turns are actually being mediated
outcome: doctor and the host make it visible when a store that requires mediation has had none, so silence cannot pass for enforcement.
acceptance: a store whose policy requires turn_gated and that has had work mutations but no control turn since a stated time says so as a warning

doctor reports when the control plane last had session activity (labelled as such, from the recorded session update time), last began a turn, last settled a turn and last recorded a turn evaluation, beside the counts it already prints, without adding a new write on the session-bind path
